evidence_selection: Selected 48 evidence entries; 210 others remain in the complete inventory. Omission is retrieval, not absence, invalidity or a competitor advantage. The full ledger remains authoritative for factual checks.

capabilities.label: Fathom's EU servers are located in Falkenstein, Helsinki, and Nuremberg.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics EU servers; located under the 'Our EU server locations' heading
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Firewall settings are adjusted by going to Settings, then Sites, clicking the site, then clicking the Firewall tab.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics firewall settings
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom's firewall offers separate list tabs for Pages, IPs, Referrers, Domains, Countries, and Events.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics firewall
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: When pages, IPs, domains, or countries are blocked in the firewall, those visitors can still access and navigate the site; only their data is excluded from the Fathom dashboard.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics firewall
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom's firewall currently supports wildcards only for IPv4 addresses.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics firewall IP wildcards; as of current documentation; does not support IPv6 wildcards
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Once one or more domains are added to the firewall's allow list, data coming from any other domain is blocked instantly.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics domain firewall; applies once at least one domain is added to the Allow list
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: A domain wildcard such as *.example.com allows only subdomains like subdomain.example.com and www.example.com, and does not allow the root domain example.com itself.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics domain firewall wildcards
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: The firewall's Events tab can drop junk or unwanted event names at collection time, or allow collection of only the event names sent on purpose.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics Events firewall
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: In the Events firewall, Block mode drops only the listed event names while still collecting every other event, Allow mode collects only the listed names and wildcard patterns, and an empty Allow list collects every event.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics Events firewall
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: After saving a change to the IP firewall list, the new list takes effect starting with the next visit.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics IP firewall
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: After saving a change to the Events firewall list, the new list takes effect starting with the next event.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics Events firewall
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: The firewall only stops future visits from being recorded; removing spam already present in reports requires using the separate Data removals feature in a site's Manage settings.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics Data removals
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom's tracking script can be installed via Fathom's WordPress plugin or via one of Fathom's other integrations.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics script installation
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom's dashboard is live and real-time, so script installation can be verified by visiting the site and checking whether the visit appears in the Realtime count at the top of the dashboard.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics dashboard
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Once allowed domains are set, Fathom filters out data from any hostname that is not on that list, including local, staging, and test domains.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics site firewall (allowed domains); Requires configuring allowed domains in site firewall settings.
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Filtering by IP address works well for a single developer or a small, stable set of IP addresses, but allowed domains are more reliable for teams and changing networks.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics IP exclusion vs allowed domains; Comparing IP-based exclusion to domain-based exclusion for blocking non-live traffic.
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: A visitor can block Fathom tracking for themselves by running fathom.blockTrackingForMe(); in the browser console on a page where Fathom is installed, which stores the setting in the browser's local storage so it keeps working for future visits from that browser.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics browser console blocking; Must be run in the browser console on a page where Fathom is installed; stored via local storage.
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom shows analytics in real time, so a non-live visit that is correctly excluded will not show up as a current visitor.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics dashboard
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: To start using Fathom Analytics, you simply have to add a single line of code to the header section of your website, where the code includes your actual Site ID.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics installation
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: A Fathom Site ID is a short, unique code that identifies a site.
capabilities.description: Source: official_documentation; Subject: Fathom Analytics Site ID
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom keeps EU visitors' personal data within the EU and stores anonymized analytics on US infrastructure.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom Data Isolation
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Data Isolation is available to all Fathom customers on all plans and works without any programming or setup required.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom Data Isolation
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Using Fathom requires no cookie notices.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom Analytics
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: If a company is based in the EU, all of its EU traffic is processed on Fathom's EU servers within EU borders, so visitors' IP addresses never reach US infrastructure.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom customers based in the EU
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: If a company is based outside the EU, Fathom automatically routes its EU visitors to EU servers.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom customers based outside the EU
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: For visitors outside the EU, Fathom's EU-owned CDN (Bunny.net) sends their pageview directly to Fathom's US servers and anonymizes their IP address data there.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom Data Isolation routing
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: For visitors inside the EU, Fathom's CDN sends their pageview to European servers, strips the IP address inside the EU before it reaches US infrastructure, and stores only anonymous data on its US servers.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom Data Isolation routing
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom's EU Cloud is monitored 24/7, highly available, and multi-region, with enough capacity to process very high ('Bieber-level') traffic.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom EU Cloud infrastructure; Capacity described only as 'Bieber-level traffic', not a quantified figure.
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom's importer lets customers import supported Google Analytics 4 data into their Fathom dashboard.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom GA4 importer
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: The GA4 importer brings in supported daily analytics available through Google's API, but does not recreate every GA4 report or import GA events.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom GA4 importer; Does not cover every GA4 report or event-level data.
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Imported GA4 data has different filtering options than data collected natively by Fathom, and totals can differ between the two tools.
capabilities.description: Source: vendor_statement; Subject: Fathom GA4 importer; Totals may not match between imported and native data.
capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom displays all data in a single-page dashboard that is easy to understand and filter without months of training.

capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: There is no setup or knowledge required to comply with GDPR with Fathom Analytics; it happens by default on every plan.

capabilities.note: Atomic product fact from the current Evidence Ledger; preserve its scope.

capabilities.label: Fathom Analytics' data retention policy is forever; as long as you're a paying customer you can view and export your data from the day you started collecting it.
